desc:
⚔️ SKIBIDI WAR — stand your ground against the toilet invasion!

Pick your operator, drop into the arena and survive wave after wave of skibidi toilets. Giant bosses crash in along the way — learn their attacks, dodge the big hits and take them down.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
• Fight solo or team up with friends in a squad
• Pick a difficulty that fits you, from a quick warm-up to a brutal marathon
• Heavy Guns: a boss rush for veterans
• Choose power-up cards between waves to build your run

🦾 OPERATORS
Cameramen, Speakermen, TV-men and giant Titans, each with their own weapons, abilities and ultimate. Upgrade them to unlock stronger versions.

🏆 PROGRESS
Earn gold and trophies, climb the ranks and leaderboards, complete daily missions and spin the wheel.

New operators, enemies and bosses arrive with updates. 👍 Like & ⭐ favorite to support the game!
